title: attachments: a parent-record editor cannot delete another user's attachment — the owner_only_deletes floor refuses before the declared parent-editor path runs
body:
Ruled: 5979859114 · letter A — parent-editor delete as a delete-only alternate match registered with the storage gate · 2026-10-04T12:21Z

QA-source: #21720 · attachments-storage.attach-requires-parent-edit · outside the item's clauses

Seen by lane L6 of the 17.7 pre-release run #21720 (subject `251a7dd4`); verifier V4 reproduced it on two fresh boots: CONFIRMED, P2. Fails closed (over-refusal), not a security hole. Predates 17.6.0.

## Reproduction

1. Scratch object `qa_att` (private, `enable.files`); a member M (invite + sign-up) with a permission set granting `qa_att` read/create/edit and `sys_attachment` read/create/edit/delete, `readScope`/`writeScope` `org` (`POST /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set` + `object_permissions` + `sys_user_permission_set`).
2. M creates a `qa_att` record (M owns it; M's PATCH → 200, so M edits the parent).
3. Admin uploads a file (presign → PUT → complete) and attaches it: `POST /api/v1/data/sys_attachment {"parent_object":"qa_att","parent_id":"{M's record}","file_id":"…"}`.
4. M: `DELETE /api/v1/data/sys_attachment/{id}` → **403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`** "You do not have access to this record"; the row stays. Control: M deletes M's own attachment → 200.

## Mechanism

The 403 comes from the platform floor `owner_only_deletes` (`object:'*'`, `created_by == current_user.id`, `positions:['org_member']`, `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts:826`), so `attachment-access-hooks`' "parent editor may delete" branch is never reached (the hook's own refusal would carry `ATTACHMENT_DELETE_DENIED`). `sys_comment` had exactly this and was fixed by the alternate-match policy `sys_comment_moderation` (`:1158`, `c25b2d52a`); `sys_attachment` has no equivalent.

## What declares the behaviour

- `packages/services/service-storage/src/attachment-access-hooks.ts:41-43`: "beforeDelete: the caller must be the uploader OR hold edit on the parent record"; unit test `attachment-access-hooks.test.ts:175` (hook in isolation).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/fixtures/attachments-fixture.ts:8-10`.
- The REST-level pin `attachments-permission-matrix.dogfood.test.ts:252-263` accepts either code and has no positive non-uploader parent-editor case, which is why this is unpinned.
